design_contract.rule: Section 10 permits numerically different package versions; each package and exact owned edge must equal its explicit accepted closure entry.

version_coupling.finding: Native facadePackageVersion must equal the selected facade closure version. Restored package identities and exact [V] dependency edges must match the closure. Generated SDK output records contain that facade version.
Output-record packageVersion must equal EngineDescriptor.PackageVersion; mismatch is rejected as NWPKG002 / InvalidManifest before native module resolution.

Both active SQLite/PostgreSQL host factories call this manifest constructor, currently hardcoded to 0.1.0-preview.1. The separate PostgreSqlEngineProfile.cs describes the older component path and is not the active Database Host factory.
Actual Server descriptor facade version is hardcoded to 0.1.0-preview.1.
Provider source-build asset records hardcode preview.1; Server uses $(Version). A16 NuGet-consumer records instead derive from the accepted package closure.

minimal_release_choice.protocol_leaf_only: A genuine new local Grpc and/or Mcp package version may retain unchanged exact Server/provider/native packages and their facade versions. Regenerate leaf closure/nuspec dependency metadata, preserve immutable existing ID/version bytes, consume both complete closures in separate processes and record the change as a protocol-package/closure upgrade and downgrade. The existing validator does not require one global version.
minimal_release_choice.scope_limit: This is not evidence of changing native engine ABI or behavior. Native tamper/incompatible-ABI negatives remain separate assembled B24 gates. Repacking a provider/Server under a new version without rebuilding its version-bound descriptor will not pass ordinary consumption.
minimal_release_choice.if_native_facade_versions_must_change: Only then fix the owning version-bound descriptor/asset-record generation coherently through the parent integrator and perform the concrete assembled version gate; no historical A16 redesign or blanket version rewrite is justified.

unchanged_acceptance_boundary: B24 implementation/execution must still wait for B22/B23 completion. The user excludes 24-hour/72-hour runs; they stay unexecuted. No public domain publication, new platform, CI matrix expansion or acceptance of unrun pristine consumers is authorized by this read-only audit.
